review_scope: Independent offline hash/assignment/operative-rule review. No web retrieval, source-data acquisition, real-case score, old suite rerun or new scientific performance metric.
integration_clarifications: Candidate readiness must be defined explicitly and kept distinct from complete/readable full-window observations and measurement admission.
Preserve every affected chain and report missing route/data as unavailable rather than zero or negative detector outcome. An Ethereum-only eventual cohort has source-limited scope.
A finite source artifact supports completeness only for its qualifying records; historical implementation/source closure is not a universal Phase14 gate.
Prior incident-informed nominations remain exposed; held-out status only relative to fixed affected methods and explicitly disclosed design history.
All 13 dispositions must close before fixed-order selection. Independent reviewer may adjudicate retained primary evidence offline; this is not fresh independent source retrieval.

scientific_assessment.established: Phase14 within-case event reconstruction and structural source feasibility; Phase8 Euler development replay.
scientific_assessment.not_established: External-case improvement in incident notification coverage, novelty or publication sufficiency.
scientific_assessment.next_decisive_evidence: At least two independently assessed incidents in two verified families, under equal budgets and full outer reference denominators, or an honestly scoped failure to meet that minimum.
scientific_assessment.negative_result: No core flow, cold start or no notification remains an outcome. A weak/null advantage can be a valid measured result without establishing an improvement claim.
